lines: Ravikumar Krishnamurthi, Promoter Group, unlocked 15,000 shares on 9 Sep 2026, 66 days ago, a recent trigger.
Shares retained are valued at ₹2.03 crore (estimate, valued at offer price); shares, not cash.
Unlock is recent, so the holding is now free to move; the 15,000 shares are not selling in the offer.
Confidence is medium: the holding appears in only one section and is not in the seller table.
